controls.title: System networking, routing, hostname, and DNS
blockers: Route, hostname, DNS, and offline-to-online transitions lack complete target-runtime evidence.

controls.title: Wi-Fi authentication and secrets workflow
blockers: Personal and enterprise Wi-Fi credential flows are not qualified on target hardware.

controls.title: Time synchronization
blockers: Wall-clock convergence and trusted source policy are not implemented and qualified end to end.

controls.title: D-Bus service continuity
blockers: The broker is packaged and ordered by Push, but startup, restart, logout, and shutdown continuity lacks full runtime evidence.

controls.title: COSMIC desktop portals
blockers: The portal is packaged and ordered after the session, but representative application invocation is not qualified.

controls.title: Audio policy and Bluetooth audio
blockers: PipeWire and WirePlumber are packaged and supervised, but native audio devices and Bluetooth profiles are not qualified.

controls.title: Credentials, accounts, and authorization
blockers: Account lifecycle, secret storage, privilege transitions, and recovery are incomplete.

controls.title: Printing and removable storage
blockers: Printing, hot-plug storage, mount policy, safe removal, and failure recovery are not qualified.

controls.title: Camera stack
blockers: Camera discovery, capture, portal authorization, suspend, and hot-plug are not qualified.

controls.title: Desktop notifications
blockers: COSMIC notification components are in the desktop bundle, but application and lifecycle behavior lacks runtime evidence.

controls.title: Automatic updates and diagnostics
blockers: Background update policy, user reporting, rollback, diagnostics capture, and redaction are incomplete.

controls.title: Locale and fonts
blockers: Locale generation, font coverage, fallback, and installer-to-session persistence are not qualified.

controls.title: Input methods and accessibility
blockers: Input methods, assistive technology, keyboard indicators, and representative device parity are incomplete.

controls.title: Power management and reconnect
blockers: Suspend, resume, device reconnect, session continuity, and shutdown remain unqualified.
